purpose: Machine-readable summary of the current AutoStop CRM MCP surface used by the manager agent.
source_documents_scope: Paths in source_documents are from the AutoStopCRM-V1 repo, not this AutostopManager checkout.
local_repo: Resolve from AUTOSTOP_CRM_ROOT; do not hard-code a user-profile path in this catalog.

manager_learning.contract: These Manager tools remain outside the 24-tool public Gateway facade. agent_mode controls work versus learning; learning records only hash-only/allowlisted technical experience. agent_case_resolver is read-only and connector-neutral; it plans or reconciles transient compact evidence but never writes business systems.

agent_gateway_v2.card_creation: No named Gateway v2 create-card workflow is advertised. After exact client and duplicate reads, resolve the literal raw name create_card, inspect its live schema, call it with a unique idempotency key, and require the Gateway exact-card readback. When linking, reread both targets and pass expected_card_updated_at plus expected_client_updated_at to link_card_to_client with a new idempotency key; require exact card/client readback. Do not call a legacy App tool and do not use agent_board_workflow for create_card.

gateway_attestation.contract: One command per invocation. Inventory freezes the exact 24 public tools, 43 CRM workflow operations, and Manager-used CRM raw capabilities. A defect blocks later cases. Mutating cases require an explicit synthetic apply, exact reread, idempotency and cleanup. Runtime evidence remains outside Git and stores hashes, sizes, timings, statuses and compact refs only.

agent_gateway_v2.required_protocol: agent_bootstrap -> agent_board_digest -> agent_search/agent_entity_context -> prepare_action_contract -> named workflow dry_run/apply -> exact-target reread and verification

store_extensions.agent_bootstrap: Returns CRM startup plus one compact stateless Store snapshot. Store failure is degraded and never makes CRM startup fail; bootstrap performs one Store request, has no cursor or ACK, and never reads or advances store_digest.
store_extensions.agent_board_digest: Backward-compatible scope=crm|store with default crm. Store scope returns one bounded store_agent_v1 page with a Manager-owned opaque cursor/ack_token pair; every non-empty page including the final source page must be ACKed before durable high-water commit.
store_extensions.agent_search: Accepts store_part, store_order, store_quote_request, store_supplier, store_batch, store_warehouse_operation, store_marketplace_listing, store_state, and lookup-only store_sourcing_offer in addition to existing CRM entities.
store_extensions.agent_entity_context: Accepts one exact allowlisted store entity/id with summary, full, or full_with_vin_photo detail. General Store reads remain redacted; exact full quote reads use the dedicated quote credential and may transiently return contacts, VIN, items, offers, notes, drafts, and bounded VIN-photo metadata without persisting them in Gateway state.
store_extensions.agent_document_workflow: download_store_quote_vin_photo retrieves only one exact JPEG VIN-photo preview when allow_large_output=true and the expected photo SHA-256 is current. The image is returned as ImageContent, while structured output and the workflow ledger contain metadata only.
store_extensions.get_runtime_status: Includes secrets-redacted store adapter configuration, circuit state, and live/degraded store health without breaking CRM health.
store_extensions.agent_inventory_workflow: Preserves existing CRM inventory operations and the seven optimized named Store operations in dry_run/apply mode; it is a fast path, not the full Store permission ceiling.
store_extensions.prepare_action_contract: Adds store_quote_request, store_batch, and store_order domains with exact target, expected_updated_at, owner intent, strict planned changes, idempotency, correlation, and readback verification.
store_extensions.raw_discovery: The legacy generic Store adapter capabilities remain INTERNAL_ONLY. get_store_analytics_report, store_owner_capabilities, and store_owner_api are explicit guarded hidden raw capabilities; owner writes still require the dedicated store:owner principal, ActionContractV2, idempotency, correlation, dry-run/preflight, and reread. None expands the 24-tool public Gateway surface.

agent_gateway_v2.virtual_api_fallback: api:/api/... capabilities cover guarded CRM reads and writes not represented by a focused MCP tool; writes remain hidden, route-hash checked, idempotent, kill-switch controlled, ledgered, and forced to the audited service identity
agent_gateway_v2.applied_write_verification_failure: workflow remains non-terminal in compensating until exact-target reconciliation
agent_gateway_v2.operator_admin_auth: public Codex/Apps use owner-approved OAuth 2.1; local codex-owner-agent internal compatibility may use the deployment bearer and is never accepted as a claimed public identity
agent_gateway_v2.mail_boundary: refs-only manager bridge; Gmail remains a separate authenticated connector and source of truth

operation_notes: In production follow one protocol: agent_bootstrap, agent_board_digest, agent_search/agent_entity_context, prepare_action_contract, named workflow dry_run/apply, then exact-target reread and verification; use lazy raw discovery only when no named workflow fits.

For AutoStop App use docs/agent/store_management_playbook.md: agent_bootstrap reports a one-request stateless degraded-safe Store snapshot; agent_board_digest(scope=store) uses the owner-visible store_digest cursor and unchanged ACK/replay/CAS; agent_search and agent_entity_context provide bounded pure reads; no Manager component reads the store database.

Manager work/learning mode is local and does not expand the 24-tool Gateway facade: resolve agent_mode at startup, use post_run_review plus agent_learning_workflow only for a learning turn, and use agent_case_resolver only as a read-only planner/reconciler before the owning CRM/Store/Gmail/OEM/web reads.

discover_raw_capabilities preserves exact-name raw escape behavior and conservatively matches natural-language technical intent only to read-only capabilities; inspect the current schema before every raw call.

For a new CRM card, first search the exact client and duplicate vehicle/card. Resolve literal create_card through the schema-hashed raw escape with a unique idempotency key and require its exact readback. Before literal link_card_to_client, reread both card and client, pass expected_card_updated_at and expected_client_updated_at with a new idempotency key, and require exact readback of both targets. Never call legacy create_card directly or send it to agent_board_workflow.

Store digest is one-page-per-call. Continue page.next_cursor until has_more=false; only the final page commits the high-water cursor. Calling again without a cursor after an abandoned read restarts from the committed checkpoint, and failures never advance it.

Seven common Store writes use prepare_action_contract plus agent_inventory_workflow as optimized named operations. All remaining owner-approved employee actions use guarded raw store_owner_capabilities/store_owner_api with the dedicated store:owner principal, live schema hash, exact refs, idempotency, correlation, schema-bound dry-run proof and operation-specific reread. Applied but unverified owner operations remain compensating.
General Drom/Avito sourcing remains parts_sourcing and service заказ-наряд remains CRM. Store marketplace routing applies only to AutoStop App export state/errors.

Legacy generic Manager Store adapters remain INTERNAL_ONLY. Use guarded raw store_owner_capabilities and store_owner_api only for employee operations not covered by a named workflow; the owner principal, schema hash, ActionContractV2, exact refs, idempotency, dry-run and reread remain mandatory.

For repair-order payments use agent_finance_workflow operation record_repair_order_payment with exact target ids, amount, payment method, current expected_updated_at, and an idempotency key. It verifies the repair-order payment row, linked cash transaction, and cash-journal entry.

If no named Gateway v2 workflow covers a required CRM capability, use discover_raw_capabilities, get_raw_capability_schema, and call_raw_capability. Guarded api:/api/<route> fallbacks never enlarge tools/list and still enforce the durable ledger, payload fingerprint, schema hash, and finance/destructive switches.
Use ping_connector/get_connector_identity/get_runtime_status only when connector availability or auth behavior is uncertain.

Start broad CRM orientation with agent_bootstrap and agent_board_digest; use agent_search and agent_entity_context for focused detail, and raw discovery only for a capability not covered by a named workflow.
Route 'готовые без оплаты' through agent_board_workflow(operation=list_ready_unpaid_cards, mode=dry_run); use operation=apply_ready_unpaid_followups in dry_run before apply.
Route 'разбери входящие' through agent_board_workflow(operation=triage_inbox_cards), then operation=cleanup_card in dry_run/apply modes only for eligible cards.

Route 'поставь таймеры' or timer-floor requests through prepare_action_contract(domain=board, action=bulk_set_deadline_if_below), then agent_board_workflow(operation=bulk_set_deadline_if_below); use 172800/173700, start in dry_run, apply with a new unique idempotency key, and do not create a duplicate manual ledger for this single named operation.
Use agent_search and agent_entity_context for focused cards, clients, and repair orders before broad exports.
Use shared_files tools for shared documents and card attachment tools for card-local attachments; do not paste file bytes into notes unless required.

For AutoStop documents without CRM cards, use create_document_without_card_pdf through the CRM print module with standard AutoStop templates; include tax_label in manual_document or request_text when the owner specifies НДС/Без НДС; omit document_type when request_text clearly says акт выполненных работ, дефектовка, заказ-наряд, счет-фактура, or продажа запчастей, because the CRM MCP client infers the standard document id from those phrases. For documents attached to CRM cards, use download_repair_order_print_pdf. Do not build independent PDF/HTML templates for AutoStop documents.
Use client_directory and client_vehicle_linking tools before creating duplicate clients or vehicles.
Use bulk_refresh_board_summaries for missing/stale board previews; use set_card_board_summary only for one-card confirmed edits and keep it under 5 non-empty lines.

For the owner command Приберись, follow docs/agent/board_cleanup_autopilot_playbook.md and docs/agent/crm_card_description_standard.md: create or update public descriptions as minimum-sufficient rich-text working handoffs, normally 4-10 short lines for nontrivial cards; preserve confirmed complaint, finding, agreement, parts state, result and customer arrangement; create an empty description only from supported useful facts; never add risks/safety caveats/source provenance/selection method/supplier-check reminders; move phone/VIN/plate/mileage/aggregates into structured client/vehicle fields; keep tags rare and capped at three; and keep board_summary as a separate short plain operator preview.

Before card description or vehicle_profile writes, read the exact card with agent_entity_context, build prepare_action_contract, then run agent_board_workflow(operation=cleanup_card) in dry_run and apply modes with expected_updated_at, a unique idempotency key, and strict reread verification.
Do not move or archive cards during routine cleanup unless the owner gives a separate explicit target/action.
If a VIN/chassis/frame number exists and vehicle_profile engine_model, gearbox_model, or drivetrain is empty, enrich only from source-backed data and preserve manual_fields.

Use decode_vehicle_identity locally before VIN-critical parts lookup when the vehicle is ROW/JDM, vPIC is partial, or CRM/manual data conflicts; verify production CRM server has the updated AutostopManager mount before relying on it through the CRM MCP endpoint.

Use catalog_provider_status and plan_oem_parts_providers locally before claiming live VIN/OEM/supplier API access; use public_aftermarket_catalog_lookup for MANN-FILTER/DENSO brand-scope catalog enrichment; use exist_price_lookup for Exist public_retail_reference only, office 905 by default, without basket/private-cabinet data; use partsapi_catalog_lookup only when PARTSAPI_KEY/PARTSAPI_BASE_URL are configured or dry-run is enough; use vin17_decode_vehicle and vin17_search_part_number_by_vin only when VIN17_ACCOUNT/VIN17_SECRET are configured or dry-run is enough; verify production CRM server has the updated AutostopManager mount before relying on these through the CRM MCP endpoint.

Use benchmark_vin_parts_lookup locally for 10-card or batch VIN/frame quality checks; it redacts raw identifiers and reports identity coverage, safe public query coverage, dry-run adapter readiness, and missing live catalog/supplier credentials.

Use build_vin_parts_work_order locally after benchmark to get per-card OEM/EPC routes, prepared API checks, cross/applicability steps, supplier sequence, CRM writeback gates, and acceptance checklists before doing live lookups.
Use today_context/memory_context_for/recall/remember/learn_from_feedback only for durable non-CRM manager memory and lessons.
Treat the autostopcrm-v1 branch in the CRM repo as canonical for new MCP commands and connector behavior.
Refresh this catalog whenever the CRM repo or AutostopManager MCP tool surface changes.

For CRM VIN/frame/body-number parts lookup and writeback planning, use plan_crm_vin_oem_parts_lookup locally; verify production CRM server has the updated AutostopManager mount before relying on it through the CRM MCP endpoint.

Use estimate_repair_work_cost for read-only labor estimates with public price averaging and public norm-hours/labor-time plausibility; do not call replace_repair_order_works from a pricing estimate unless the owner separately approves the exact ЗН write.

schema_notes.live_discovery_rule: Before CRM writes, prefer the currently exposed MCP/tool schema over stale docs or static wrappers.
schema_notes.set_card_deadline: Deadline-capable CRM tools accept duration-style payloads such as days/hours/minutes/seconds or total_seconds. create_card preserves a positive total_seconds through the MCP client; compare the returned duration and exact reread before confirming an appointment timer.
schema_notes.write_response_mode: High-traffic CRM write tools accept response_mode=full|compact; manager operations always return compact run metadata with scanned/eligible/changed/skipped/errors/verification.
schema_notes.repair_order_privacy: list_repair_orders accepts compact=true and redact_private=true for low-payload diagnostics without client phone/VIN fields.
schema_notes.manager_operation_modes: Invoke bulk_set_deadline_if_below, bulk_refresh_board_summaries, cleanup_card, and apply_ready_unpaid_followups through agent_board_workflow. Start with mode=dry_run; mode=apply requires a new unique idempotency key and returns compact verification. The named workflow owns its ledger, records mode/dry_run, and does not need a duplicate manual start_workflow for a single operation.
schema_notes.agent_board_digest_store_scope: scope defaults to crm for backward compatibility. scope=store accepts since, cursor, optional matching ack_token, and bounded limit; every non-empty page requires ACK and raw App cursors are not exposed. agent_bootstrap is stateless, has no Store continuation fields, and never consumes store_digest.
schema_notes.agent_search_store_entities: Existing CRM entity schemas remain unchanged. Store entities use compact snake_case DTOs, opaque cursors, strict limits, and general contact redaction.
schema_notes.agent_inventory_workflow_store_mode: Store mode accepts one optimized named operation, payload with domain/target_id/expected_updated_at/owner_intent/planned_changes/correlation_id, idempotency_key, and mode=dry_run|apply. Other employee mutations route only through the separately guarded owner capability/API pair.
schema_notes.store_outage: Store transport, auth, or schema failure appears only as a store degraded warning/status; CRM reads and writes keep their existing behavior.
schema_notes.read_only_vin_oem_tools: decode_vehicle_identity, partsapi_catalog_lookup, and lookup_oem_catalog_candidates are read-only raw capabilities. They do not require a write idempotency key or a workflow ledger; provider blocks and empty candidates are reported as inconclusive evidence.
schema_notes.write_scope: All CRM tools operate only on the current AutoStop CRM board served by this MCP/API endpoint.
schema_notes.autostop_document_printing: create_document_without_card_pdf accepts request_text, optional document_type, manual_document, selected_template_ids, and print_settings; manual_document may include tax_label such as НДС (5%) or Без НДС, and request_text may include a line like НДС: Без НДС. When document_type is omitted or auto, the CRM MCP client infers invoice, invoice_factura, completion_act, vehicle_acceptance_act, repair_order, inspection_sheet, or parts_sale from Russian request_text phrases. It renders application/pdf via the same CRM print module, PrintServiceProfile, standard AutoStop templates, template engine, and PDF render as card-based printing.
